symptom: The admin home page title bar reads 'Dashboard' where the app and its users expect 'Homepage'; any caption-based check or screenshot comparison on the home page fails.
why_plausible: A translation or terminology pass during a Studio Pro upgrade regenerates Texts$Text items and picks a different en_US string; the replacement is a plain string swap that nothing else validates.

symptom: The admin grid lists only responses that are still open (not completed) instead of completed responses, so the summary shows the wrong population of rows.
why_plausible: An XPath normaliser or a Studio Pro conversion that rewrites boolean comparisons to not(...) form inverts the constraint when the attribute is a Boolean; the grid still renders, so the change looks harmless.

symptom: The whole data view on the admin home page disappears for every user; only the top bar remains and the page looks empty.
why_plausible: A conditional-visibility expression that cannot be converted to the new expression engine is replaced with a constant 'false' by an automated conversion, which hides the widget silently.

symptom: A leave request whose end date equals its start date (a single-day leave) now passes validation, although the rule was meant to reject end dates that are not after the start date.
why_plausible: Operator normalisation during a BRD-to-MDL or Studio Pro round-trip turns a strict comparison into an inclusive one; the expression still parses and the microflow still validates, so nothing flags it.

symptom: The holiday calculation stops one day early, so the last day of every leave request is not counted as leave and the requested-days total is too high.
why_plausible: An off-by-one repair applied while re-expressing the loop exit condition in a newer expression syntax; the loop terminates normally, so no error is raised.

symptom: The average rating shown on content is computed in memory but never saved, so it stays at its old value after a new comment is published.
why_plausible: An upgrade or automated repair that normalises commit settings to the 'No' default on a ChangeAction drops the commit, while the in-memory change still appears to succeed within the same request.

symptom: The green 'Add content' button on the Manage page is visible but does nothing when clicked; no create form opens.
why_plausible: A client-action conversion that cannot map the create-object action to the new button model falls back to a no-op action, leaving the button in place with no error at build time.

symptom: Plain ContentPortal users, who should only read content, can open the Publish page by URL and see the publish form.
why_plausible: A security sync that copies the allowed-role list from a sibling page (or a role-mapping repair that expands a role alias) widens the page to an extra module role; the page still renders correctly for managers.

symptom: Car design model names saved with leading or trailing spaces are stored as typed, so later lookups by exact model name miss the record.
why_plausible: A conversion that rewrites a function call expression to the platform's new attribute syntax drops the trim() wrapper; the attribute still receives a string, so type checking passes.

symptom: New purchase requests are created already in the Finished state, so they skip the approval workflow and show as completed on the dashboard.
why_plausible: A domain-model import or a defaults re-mapping during an upgrade copies a default from another enumeration value; the attribute default is stored as plain text and is not validated against the workflow.

symptom: A purchase request whose total is exactly equal to the second-approval threshold no longer goes to the second approver.
why_plausible: A boundary-operator change while porting the threshold check to the new expression language (>= rewritten as >) is invisible to a compile check and only shows at the exact threshold value.

symptom: Administrators calling the email lookup get a permission error because MendixSSO.Administrator is no longer allowed to run this microflow.
why_plausible: When a Marketplace module is updated to a new version, its allowed-role lists are reset to the defaults of the new release, dropping roles the app had customised.
